messages:
maya: Heads-up — publish job failed on typegen regendiff check, looks like only CHANGELOG header mutated (timezone format).

ci-bot: [automated] Job 'publish' failed: typegen-regendiff. Log: https://ci.redwood.example/2769991111/logs

kevin: I saw a similar wobble after the npm install pulled typegen v1.5.1 locally; CI image had v1.4.2.

patrick: Can we pin the typegen release in the workflow? Hotfix first, then proper canonicalizer.

zoe: Agreed. Also propose we add a normalization step in regendiff: strip ISO vs RFC timestamp differences before diffing.

maya: Opening a small PR to pin to v1.4.2 and adding a comment. Will file canonicalizer issue.

ci-bot: Created issue #501: "Normalize changelog header timestamps for deterministic typegen diffs" (assigned: zoe)

kevin: Adding a unit test in typegen that regenerates with fixed GIT_AUTHOR_DATE to assert no differences will help.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/912 — pins typegen and documents plan. cc @kevin for review.

zoe: I'll write the canonicalizer design in the issue and drop a sample script. Let's not let timestamp formatting block releases.

kevin: LGTM once green. Thanks folks.
